# Approved commit-metadata email addresses.
#
# An approved public authoring identity is a deliberately published address the
# maintainer has chosen to sign the fleet's commits with; it is part of the
# public history of the unbraind/pm-* repositories and may be allowlisted here.
# An unapproved identity is any address not listed below: the audit fails closed
# on it, and adding an address here never converts a privacy violation into an
# approval — only a maintainer decision recorded in the tracker may approve an
# authoring identity.
# The maintainer's approved public authoring identity per the 2026-07-21
# decision (see pm-vcs-mhbz closure). Present in the public history of every
# unbraind/pm-* repo; intentionally retained, not rewritten.
stefan@preu.at
